evidence: Guest checkout walked on 2026-10-16: cart, contact and address step, card option, Adyen secured-field fill (verification card), Pay clicked once and the page answered with a payment-failed message. Signup and sign-in were not proven.
gotchas: Accept the cookie banner with #cookiescript_accept first: it has no reject button and its overlay blocks every click.
Cart add buttons carry digits in their aria-label; click [role=group]:has(h4:has-text("<product name>")) button:has(svg) instead.
Checkout contact inputs: [name=email], [name=firstName], [name=lastName], [name=streetName], [name=streetNumber], [name=postalCode], [name=city]; the street field is a combobox.

Card fields are three Adyen frames: expiry iframe[title*="Ablauf" i] (format 01/30), number iframe[title*="Kartennummer" i], CVV iframe[title*="Sicherheits" i]; fill expiry, then number and CVV back to back.
Pay button is the visible button containing 'zahlungspflichtig'; clicked once, the page showed a payment-failed message matching text=/Zahlung.*(nicht|fehl)/i (exact element not pinned down).

Account signup at /ch-de/customer/account/create: [name=email], password, [name=passwordConfirm], [name=firstName], [name=lastName]; submit raised no visible error but no signed-in state or mail followed, so signup and sign-in are unproven.

route.note: On the contact step type email, firstName, lastName, streetName, streetNumber, postalCode and city (Switzerland is preselected), click 'Zum Versand & Zahlung', then pick the card payment option by its 'Karte' label.
